reason: The Ledger port and SqliteLedger have no acquireRunLease, renewRunLease, releaseRunLease, recordRunCheckpoint, latestRunCheckpoint, listRunCheckpoints, storeRunContract, getRunContract, recordRunStep, getRunSteps or listRuns yet, so each call throws TypeError (not a function). tests 28, pass 10 (the Task 1 tracer cases), fail 18.

run leases: grants a free lease with fence 1, refuses a live one with conflict, and takes over only a strictly expired one (fence 2)
renews only for the current holder and fence; a fenced-out holder is refused with conflict
release clears holder and expiry, keeps counting fences, and refuses a stale releaser
fences out a stale supervisor: after takeover its transition is a conflict and writes nothing (T-02-05)
never leases an onboarding carrier row or an unknown run
two connections racing an expired run lease: exactly one wins (NFR-5: writers serialize through BEGIN IMMEDIATE)
run checkpoints: appends with the next seq without moving the state or the version, and records the event
keeps seq continuous across transitions and plain checkpoints; latest is the highest, list is oldest first
refuses an attempt of another run, a stale fence and an unknown run
run contracts and budgets: stores the contract and its budget rows in one transaction and reads the highest version back
refuses a second store of the same version with conflict and leaves the first contract and its budgets alone
refuses a stale fence, an oversized body, an invalid budget and an unknown run, writing nothing
refuses an UPDATE of a stored contract body (the Phase 1 trigger covers run contracts)
run steps: records a step by (step, attempt), replaces a repeated one, and reads them oldest first
accepts exactly the six step statuses
refuses a result body over 1 MiB and an unknown run, and never writes to the onboarding step table
listRuns: returns runs oldest first, filtered by project, and never an onboarding carrier row
does not list the carrier row a real onboarding creates through storeContract
